newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT-Bank Hapoalim rated a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Bank Hapoalim rated a buy.

text.p: Israel's Ilanot Batucha has rated Bank Hapoalim a buy because it expects its financial results to continue to expand, the company said in a report on Wednesday.
Hapoalim's financial results will be influenced by a drastically smaller provision for doubtful debt, incresed operating revenues and increased profit from subsidiaries, the report said.
"The renewed interest in the stock market...will increase the amount of commissions from the stock market and from the management of mutual funds," the report said.
Ilanot Batucha estimated the bank's net profit for 1997 at about 944 million shekels.
